row.body: The cattle auction ledger lists every lot sold, but the gate key is returned before the buyers’ vehicles are counted.
row.title: Auction lot count

sidecar.gloss: The gate closes before the buyer vehicles are counted.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm office could close the gate before vehicles left for ordinary reasons; the ledger does not show who remained.

row.body: the lighter and empty garden sprayer carry animal-feed grit under a strip of barrier tape. neither layer fully covers the other.
row.title: two traces on the lighter

sidecar.gloss: Farm residue and response markings share one deliberately ambiguous bundle.
sidecar.rival_reading: The farm program and the emergency response each explain one layer of the bundle, and the shared knot does not establish which purpose came first.
